breakouts.h: Coming for your Saturdays: this year's breakout candidates
breakouts.d: Rating jumps from offseason training, new starting jobs, scheme fits and what they did with limited snaps last year. These are the names to know before kickoff.

list.name: C.Diabate
list.d: [[p:557726463|C.Diabate]] slides into the starting lineup with J.Westerman gone. On top of that, Ole Miss threw it more than almost anyone last year (15th in passing yards per game). He averaged 16.2 yards a catch in a limited role. Circle his name now.

list.d: [[p:557717760|S.Blunt]] ran for 7.3 yards a carry as a backup. On top of that, Ohio State leans on the run game (8th in rushing yards per game last year). He brings a contact seeker skill set to a scheme that ranks 15th in rushing yards per game. Ohio State fans are about to get a new favorite player.
